title: 부동산등기특별조치법에따른대법원규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:01128:19900821:00001:part:1/1

ADDENDUM <No. 1128, August 21, 1990>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on September 2, 1990.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures) A contract executed on a form certified by the head of a Si, etc. under the previous provisions before these Rules enter into force shall be deemed certified under these Rules.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Rules) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Real Estate Registration Act shall be amended as follows:

Article 51-2 of the Enforcement Rules of the Real Estate Registration Act shall be deleted, and Article 105 (2) of those Rules shall be amended as follows:

(2) A person applying for registration for which transmission is required under paragraph (1) shall submit a duplicate of the application specifying the following matters:

(a) The year, month and day on which the registration obligor registered the acquisition of the right;

(b) The standard value for taxation of the real estate.
